key_findings.finding: The SELFIES resolves to methylamine (CN), methanol (CO), and the chlorinated diazine ClC1=NC=C(Cl)C(Cl)=N1, represented in the reaction database as Clc1ncc(Cl)c(Cl)n1. This is a triazine-like electrophile only in the broad sense of an electron-poor N-heteroaromatic; structurally it is a dichloro/trichloro pyrimidine-type ring with two ring nitrogens, not a 1,3,5-triazine (which would have three ring nitrogens).
